crossRefs.note: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell among a people of unclean…
Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to…
for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
For the love of Christ constrains us; because we judge thus, that one died for all, therefore all died.
He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose…

translations.web: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?
translations.bsb: How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?
translations.kjv: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits
translations.asv: What shall I render unto Jehovah For all his benefits toward me?
